page.overview:
Who is Bert Fenster?

Bert Fenster is a Jurassic World park employee who appeared in LEGO Jurassic World: Legend of Isla Nublar.

After getting convicned by Hudson Harper, he lets him into the Aviary, despite being closed. After Hudson gets attacked and taken by a Pteranodon, he calls Vic Hoskins to alert security. When calling he pretended to be an anonymous park guest to avoid getting in trouble.
